sections.description: Sends all WordPress mail through your own SMTP server, logs every message, and lets you preview or resend it.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Optionally file a copy of each sent message in the mailbox's Sent folder over IMAP.
  • Sent folder detected automatically, with a manual override.

1.2.0

  • Renamed to Helo, with a new menu icon.
  • Email log is now a two-pane mail client view.
  • Existing settings and logs are adopted automatically.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned admin screens.
  • Self-hosted updates.

1.0.0

  • First release.
